players.product: substrate / package maker buying Hanmi PCB saw-vision equipment

quarterly_data.signal: LG Innotek is partnering with NVIDIA to develop sensing solutions for physical AI and robots: at GTC Berlin (October 20) it showed a 3MP camera module and a multi-modal vision system applying NVIDIA's Holoscan Sensor Bridge technology, and the two companies plan to expand cooperation to robot vision sensing and robot hands, with next-generation solutions to be unveiled next year.
